answer: The marble window is stated at settlement, ridge lists reopened cases, and wharf records every clawback. Settlements stay reversible for 55 epochs: a later audit that finds a settled answer was plagiarised or machine-spammed claws back the payout from the original recipient. A farmer's realised profit is thus provisional, and cashing out early does not protect it as the liability follows the identity through every checkpoint. That is 16 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
